location.title: Location
location.intro: We love traveling and discovering magical places, and we couldn’t imagine a better setting to celebrate our love than Guatapé - a colorful, joyful village surrounded by water, mountains, and sky. This special place captures the energy of the four elements, inviting adventure, beauty, and connection. We want to share this unforgettable moment with our family and friends, enjoying the breathtaking views, vibrant streets, and the unique spirit that makes Guatapé so full of life and adventures.
location.roadWarning: The road may easily be passed.

hotels.title: Hotel Options
hotels.subtitle: Here are a few options you might consider. Of course, you can also explore other nearby places close to the venue that better match your taste or budget - there are many options available.

cristalinaCabana.name: Cabaña Cristalina
cristalinaCabana.description: Spacious villa with BBQ area and views of the lake, mountains, and landmarks.
cristalinaCabana.hint: Perfect for groups or families - spacious villa with breathtaking views.

fincamariangel.name: Finca Hotel Mariaangel
fincamariangel.description: Hotel 8 minutes from the venue with comfortable rooms, pool, restaurant, and magnificent lake views.
fincamariangel.hint: Not listed online. Best to call directly.

portomarina.name: Hotel Porto Marina
portomarina.hint: Luxurious rooms with balconies, private beach with Peruvian/Caribbean cuisine and cocktails.

monteGandolfo.name: Monte Gandolfo
monteGandolfo.description: Near Piedra del Peñol with garden, terrace, and access to shared hot tub, some with kitchen.
monteGandolfo.hint: Quiet, scenic location - arrange transport as it's a short drive from town.

viajeroHostal.name: Viajero Hostal
viajeroHostal.description: Lake views, relaxed social atmosphere, communal areas to meet people, and restaurants.
viajeroHostal.hint: Book in advance for a discount.

recuerdos.name: Hotel Recuerdos
recuerdos.description: Hotel with heated outdoor pool, bar, gym, Turkish bath, nightclub, and modern rooms, hot tubs, and lake views.
recuerdos.hint: Shuttles to the international airport can be arranged for a fee. Free parking.

altoLunaGlamping.name: Alto Luna Glamping
altoLunaGlamping.description: Private cabin. The perfect place to find peace and enjoy panoramic views of Peñol Rock.
altoLunaGlamping.hint: Remote cabin; limited amenities and fills up quickly - please book early.

questions.question: Are children welcome?
questions.answer: Yes, children are welcome. Please inform us if they will attend.

questions.question: Who can I contact with questions?
questions.answer: Please write to us via the WhatsApp group or directly to Maria or Chris.

questions.question: What should I pack?
questions.answer: Swimmers, comfortable shoes (no heels - there will be grass and a lot of walking), warm clothes for the night as it will be chill, clothes for yoga/sports, and good energy. The night may be cold. Bring a blanket if possible.

questions.question: What's the weather like in Guatapé?
questions.answer: During the day it's pleasantly warm; evenings can get cool. Bring something light for the daytime and a jacket or sweater for the evening.

questions.question: Which gifts?
questions.answer: We want you to know that the greatest gift for us is your journey and presence at our special day. If you still want to give us something, please consider that we are digital nomads who travel very light.

questions.question: Until when do I need to confirm my attendance?
questions.answer: Please let us know by October 31, 2025.

questions.question: How do I upload photos and videos?
questions.answer: On the media page, click 'Click to select photos or videos' to choose your files. You can select multiple files at once. Once selected, click 'Upload Media' to share them with us.

questions.question: How long will my uploaded media be available?
questions.answer: Uploaded photos and videos will be available for viewing on the site for at least 6 months after the wedding. We'll notify you if there's any change to this timeline.

story.title: Our Story
story.subtitle: Once upon a time, Chris went to Colombia while Maria was living in Australia. Few years later Chris left Europe to visit Australia in the exact moment when Maria left Australia to travel in Europe (great timing, universe 👏)
story.paragraph2: Maria went to a salsa festival in Croatia looking for a soulmate. And she did find one… it was Caro. Instant best friend! Together they went to the festival three years in a row. In the fourth year Caro skipped the salsa and went to another event with her "good friend" (spoiler: that was Chris 👀).
story.paragraph3: Maria kept traveling and eventually landed at a digital nomad festival in Bulgaria. Caro messaged her: "my "good friend" is there, you should meet him!" …but never shared his contact (thanks, Caro). The universe clearly had a plan. That same weekend, Maria and Chris bumped into each other while trying to escape a busy and noisy party. They started talking, lost track of time, and didn't notice everyone else had already left.
story.paragraph4: The next morning, Maria went for a 7am run. Chris went to the park to work out. They crossed paths again… and from that moment, they never separated.
story.paragraph5: In their first year, they traveled through 14 countries together. Proof that one conversation can turn into a whole adventure. What began as "just one conversation" turned into love, adventure, and now this wedding that we are looking forward to celebrating together. 🎉💍
